content: अनीह {%a.%} .²1 Indifferent, listless. एकान्तेन ह्यनीहोऽयं पराभवति पूरुषः <ls>Mb. 3. 32. 39</ls>. .²2 Not industrious, lazy; ऋणं धारयमाणस्य कुतः सुखमनीहया <ls>Mb. 5. 107. 6</ls>. .{@-हः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a king of Ayodhyā. .{@-हा@} Disregard, apathy, indifference, disinclination; अनीहया <ls>Ki. 2. 10</ls> carelessly.
